[[Falaharn's Split Chakrams]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Falaharn Mistwarden]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Morostav Trail]], or [[Warden of Saprophytes]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Ferndale]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30
